title: Shiv — Arena
description: News and commentary across the spectrum — Breaking Points, Ezra Klein, Pivot, Daily Show, and adjacent voices. One or two episodes per drop; not a doomscroll.
author: Shivanshu Chaudhary

items.title: Are Prediction Markets Gambling? A Lot Rides on the Answer. (The Daily)
items.description:
The Daily on the legal fight over prediction markets like Kalshi and Polymarket — and why Republican and Democratic states are both arguing that these platforms are gambling.

Watch: https://youtu.be/HgbFUwcjZEE

items.title: Bill Gates’s Blunt Warning on A.I. (The Ezra Klein Show)
items.description:
Ezra Klein talks with Bill Gates about near-term AI risks — cyberattacks, bioterror, and job loss — and why Gates thinks government safeguards can’t wait on industry self-regulation.

Episode: https://www.nytimes.com/2026/09/29/opinion/ezra-klein-podcast-bill-gates.html

items.title: I have some questions for Mark Zuckerberg (Decoder with Nilay Patel)
items.description:
Nilay Patel runs through the questions he would ask Mark Zuckerberg after Meta’s Connect week and Muse launch — using Zuckerberg’s Sources interview when Meta declined Decoder.

Watch: https://youtu.be/8hwcDaX3ISg

Episode: https://podcasts.apple.com/us/podcast/i-have-some-questions-for-mark-zuckerberg/id1011668648?i=1000791435415

items.title: Republicans Are Running From Trump. Will It Work? (Radio Atlantic)
items.description:
As some Republicans back away from Trump over Iran, diesel prices, and affordability, Trump is not getting mad at them — a look at lame-duck politics and midterm positioning.

Watch: https://youtu.be/GfXIxpD_1vY

Episode: https://podcasts.apple.com/us/podcast/republicans-are-running-from-trump-will-it-work/id1258635512?i=1000792087863

items.title: The SaaSpocalypse that wasn't, with Atlassian's CEO (Decoder with Nilay Patel)
items.description:
Nilay Patel with Atlassian co-founder and CEO Mike Cannon-Brookes on the supposed “SaaSpocalypse,” AI in the enterprise, and why he thinks Jira/Trello-class platforms aren’t about to disappear.

Watch: https://youtu.be/BkPZBVuxhsU

Episode: https://www.theverge.com/podcast/1000914/atlassian-ceo-mike-cannon-brookes-saaspocalypse-ai-enterprise-software-trello-jira

items.title: He Was Deported to a Country He’d Never Heard Of (The Daily)
items.description: The Daily on third-country deportations: one man’s removal to a nation he had never been to, and how the Trump administration is using that strategy to expand removals.

items.title: What the 'Godfather of AI' Thinks Humanity Should Do (Radio Atlantic)
items.description:
Geoffrey Hinton on Radio Atlantic: what alarmed him about recent agent behavior, extinction-risk odds he still stands behind, and why he wants regulation that looks more like drug approval than vibes.

Episode: https://podcasts.apple.com/us/podcast/what-the-godfather-of-ai-thinks-humanity-should-do/id1258635512?i=1000791442422

items.title: Fareed Zakaria on America's Retreat from the World (The Prof G Pod with Scott Galloway)
items.show: The Prof G Pod with Scott Galloway
items.description:
Scott Galloway with Fareed Zakaria on whether the U.S. is losing influence abroad — Iran and the Gulf, Canada’s trade shift, Ukraine, China, and what midterms could change.

Episode: https://www.profgmedia.com/p/fareed-zakaria-on-americas-retreat

items.title: A More United Nations with PM Pedro Sánchez of Spain (The Weekly Show with Jon Stewart)
items.show: The Weekly Show with Jon Stewart
items.description:
Jon Stewart talks with Spain’s Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez during UN General Assembly week about multilateralism, governing from the left, and what middle powers can still do in a fractured order.

Watch: https://youtu.be/p6XvTconhwQ

items.title: Can Cloudflare save the web from AI? (Decoder with Nilay Patel)
items.description:
Decoder with Nilay Patel and Cloudflare CEO Matthew Prince on micropayments, default-block crawlers, and whether bot-first incentives hollow out human publishing.

Watch: https://youtu.be/4t8RhKbkb70

Episode: https://www.theverge.com/podcast/1000344/cloudflare-matthew-prince-google-zero-ai-web-advertising

items.title: What Does Abdul El-Sayed Believe? (The Ezra Klein Show)
items.description:
Ezra Klein maps Abdul El-Sayed’s worldview — public-health left ideology pressed into governing tradeoffs, not a doomscroll headline dump.

Watch: https://youtu.be/f7MVyjL-rbk

Episode: https://www.nytimes.com/2026/09/25/opinion/ezra-klein-podcast-abdul-el-sayed.html

items.title: Can John Ternus find Apple's next big thing? (Decoder with Nilay Patel)
items.description: Decoder with Nilay Patel and Mark Gurman on John Ternus’s first major Apple launch — succession narrative, product theater, and how sourcing shapes the Apple story.

items.title: Jensen Huang Thinks A.I. Alarmism Has Gone Too Far (The Ezra Klein Show)
items.description:
Ezra Klein with Nvidia’s Jensen Huang on AI alarmism, chips, and influence — the power debate from the company that sells the picks and shovels.

Watch: https://youtu.be/HjurAWAr_nY

Episode: https://www.nytimes.com/2026/09/22/opinion/ezra-klein-podcast-jensen-huang.html

items.title: Trump's Press Crackdown, Paramount Settles, and Anthropic's $2 Trillion IPO (Pivot)
items.description:
Pivot with Kara Swisher and Scott Galloway on Trump’s press crackdown, Paramount’s settlement, and Anthropic’s mega-IPO talk — media power under deadline heat.

Watch: https://youtu.be/pPTy2vFtiP8

items.title: White House Bans Media Outlets & MAGA Embraces AI While Demonizing Immigrants | Ari Emanuel (The Daily Show: Ears Edition)
items.description: The Daily Show with Jon Stewart on White House media bans, MAGA’s AI embrace, and immigrant rhetoric — plus Ari Emanuel; comedy as access theater.

items.show: Breaking Points with Krystal and Saagar
items.description:
Breaking Points: false AI intel nearly triggers a China intercept; diesel prices spike; Ed Sheeran’s Palestine apology becomes the day’s emotional frame.

items.title: Zuck's AI Safety Pitch, Canada Turns to Europe, and Kash Patel on Bestiality (Pivot)
items.description:
Pivot on Zuckerberg’s AI-safety pitch, Canada turning toward Europe, and Kash Patel’s oddest headline — media craft while the news cycle itself is the bit.

Watch: https://youtu.be/RupPxZkm1Nk

items.title: What ‘Hyperpolitics’ Explains About This Era (The Ezra Klein Show)
items.description:
Ezra Klein on “hyperpolitics”: movements that saturate culture overnight, then evaporate — intense engagement paired with little lasting policy change.

Watch: https://youtu.be/PurFyLK-zlk

Episode: https://podcasts.apple.com/us/podcast/what-hyperpolitics-explains-about-this-era/id1548604447?i=1000788429329

items.title: Ep. #742: Jessica Tarlov, Kevin Roose, Christopher Rufo (Real Time with Bill Maher)
items.description:
Real Time with Bill Maher: Jessica Tarlov, Kevin Roose, and Christopher Rufo — panel combat on politics, tech, and culture war (aired 9/18/26).

Episode: https://podcasts.apple.com/us/podcast/ep-742-jessica-tarlov-kevin-roose-christopher-rufo/id98746009?i=1000790640677

items.title: We Can't Lose Control of A.I. (The Ezra Klein Show)
items.description:
Ezra Klein on AI control: why slowing down isn’t enough if labs are on the cusp of recursive self-improvement — and what coordinated restraint would actually require.

Watch: https://youtu.be/fjZ90V_JREk

Episode: https://podcasts.apple.com/us/podcast/we-cant-lose-control-of-a-i/id1548604447?i=1000790744856&uo=4

items.show: Breaking Points with Krystal and Saagar
items.description:
Breaking Points: Fed rate hike, diesel shortages, Derek Thompson on polling that shows most Americans fear AI could destroy humanity, and a US vessel struck by Iran.
